title: Pipeline Run Output (v2.0, flat)
description: Flat-structure run JSON written to runs/[PROGRAM]/latest.json by functions/program-intake-spec.md. This is a DIFFERENT, incompatible schema from run-output.schema.json (v1.1, nested run_manifest/program_state structure) used by engine/program-pipeline-orchestrator.md. Both schemas are in live use: iso42001 and hds run on v2.0 (this file); 62443 and customer-portal-ugc-sso run on v1.1. This split is a known structural debt item — see OPTIMIZATION-ROADMAP.md Phase 3 (schema version migration). New programs should use this v2.0 flat schema; do not introduce new v1.1 programs. Decision 2026-07-29 (see OPTIMIZATION-ROADMAP.md Phase 4): rather than force-fit every program's live content into a single rigid shape, this schema now formally documents three extension points (vendor_output, monitoring_output, program_extensions) so genuinely program-specific top-level content has a declared, discoverable home instead of being an undocumented ad-hoc field. Migrating existing 62443 / customer-portal-ugc-sso content into these fields is a separate, not-yet-executed follow-up — see the same roadmap section for why that migration itself carries data-loss risk on live audit programs and has not been done.

control_coverage.description: Populated by full_build only; null on standard runs.

risk_register.description: Populated by full_build only; null on standard runs.

evidence_calendar.description: Populated by full_build only; null on standard runs.

vendor_output.description: Optional. Third-party/vendor risk management output — vendor scorecards, remediation plans, TPRM assessments. Present when the program's monitoring cadence includes vendor risk tracking (e.g. 62443). Deliberately unstructured beyond object type — shape varies by program; do not force a common sub-schema until at least 2 programs' real usage has been compared.

monitoring_output.description: Optional. Output of a monitoring_run pass that doesn't fit control_coverage/risk_register — decision queue, watch list, escalation items, draft communications staged for lead PM review. Present when a program runs recurring monitoring_run cycles between full_build passes (e.g. 62443).

program_extensions.description: Optional. Namespaced container for genuinely program-specific top-level content that has no home in the shared schema (e.g. audit-team rosters, activity calendars, agentic-automation posture, dated lead_pm_ground_truth_*/lead_pm_status_* snapshot blocks). Key names inside this object are program-defined and not enumerated here by design — the point is to distinguish 'core schema, shared meaning' from 'program-specific extension' at the top level, so validate_schema_drift.py and future tooling can tell the difference instead of every extension looking like an undeclared core-schema key.
